caption: The drawing features a statue of a standing human figure positioned on a round, cut wooden base. The figure wears a feathered headdress comprised of several large, upright feathers in shades of brown and muted gold. The statue's face is frontal, with shoulder-length, dark brown hair. The figure's right arm is bent at the elbow and raised, while the left arm is bent downwards and extends slightly forward. The figure is dressed in a short tan tunic with decorative fringes at the bottom, a belt, and layered ornamental details across the chest in gold and muted red tones. Drape-like elements fall over the shoulders and down the back in reddish-brown hues. The figure also wears knee-high boots in a light brown color. The overall color composition employs subdued earth tones such as brown, gold, tan, and red. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or features present in the drawing.
title: Cigar Store Indian
